scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

Vasconcelos gives 1970 for transfer; DOBES gives residence since 1973; Grund reconstructs a sequence of displacement in the early 1970s. The phase is deliberately approximate, with demarcation in 1983 separately identified.
The historical labels Huari and Mondé must not merge Aikanã with Wari or the Mondé language family.
The two DOBES pages are counted as one work for the source budget.
The 2018 book concerns a specific shared Kwazá Aikanã community in Kwazá do Rio São Pedro, not an assertion that all Aikanã and Kwaza are one people.
Cascata remains are not assigned an unverified archaeological date or exclusive ethnicity. No precise burial location or restricted ritual account is reproduced.
Older population counts, living-speaker estimates and references to the oldest elder are not represented as current.
The imported 1492 to 1500 polygon and lifetime remain unverified; independent historical review is pending.
